title: Code for "Reciprocal sums of Pisot linear recurrences: effective rounding and the asymptotics of the error"
description: Python scripts accompanying the paper "Reciprocal sums of Pisot linear recurrences: effective rounding and the asymptotics of the error" by A. Suna and P. K. Ray. The scripts reproduce the constants, starting indices and root-free bounds in Tables 1-3 (verify_pisot.py), the error-expansion comparisons of Tables 4-5 and the numerical observations of Section 6 (check_error_asymptotics.py), and the remaining numerical claims of Section 6 (verify_claims.py). All computations use mpmath multiprecision floating-point arithmetic with explicit precision margins; no interval arithmetic is used, so the results are computer-assisted, not formally certified. Requires Python 3.9+ and mpmath 1.3 (see requirements.txt).
